'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[SDF–Syrian Transitional Government clashes (2025–present)|SDF–Syrian Transitional Government clashes]]
***The [[Syria]]n [[Syrian transitional government|government]] announces an immediate ceasefire with the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] following clashes last night that killed at least four people and injured at least eight others. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-aleppo-clashes-sdf-sheikh-maqsoud-49ecf8d056e4558848c9c442eb22359f (AP)]
**[[US intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[United States Central Command]] announces that US forces conducted a strike in Syria on October 2, killing Muhammad ‘Abd-al-Wahhab al-Ahmad, a senior [[Jama'at Ansar al-Islam]] attack planner. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/other/us-military-kills-senior-al-qaeda-affiliated-attack-planner/ar-AA1O2UNd?ocid=BingNewsVerp (''The Hill'')]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Houthi]] rebels detain nine [[United Nations]] workers in [[Yemen]] as part of a long-term crackdown on UN presence in the country, bringing the total number of detained UN personnel to 53. [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-houthis-un-staff-crackdown-e718b7fd395d34b874b36796847c8f7e (AP)]
**The [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[Department of Migrant Workers]] confirms the death of a critically injured [[Filipinos|Filipino]] crew member of MV ''Minervagracht'' which was intercepted by the Houthis in the [[Gulf of Aden]] on September 29. The [[Netherlands]]-based operator of the vessel has reported that another injured Filipino is still being treated in [[Djibouti]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2120958/filseafarer-dies-after-september-29-houthi-attack-on-mv-minervagracht (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/crew-member-of-dutch-cargo-ship-dies-of-injuries-sustained-in-houthi-attack-last-week/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*The value of [[gold]] [[futures contract|futures]] rise above $4,000 per [[Troy weight#Troy ounce|troy ounce]] for the first time in trading history. [https://apnews.com/article/gold-record-price-silver-shutdown-fbe2b3c43780923569a7b5db1a55f06b (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Al-Khoziny Islamic Boarding School collapse]]
**The death toll from the collapse of a ''[[pesantren]]'' last week in [[East Java]], [[Java]], Indonesia, rises to 67 as search and rescue operations end. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/oct/07/ndonesia-school-collapse-search-for-victims-ends-as-67-confirmed-dead (The Guardian)]
*[[Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling]]
**Four people are killed, including a girl, after a boat carrying migrants sinks off the coast of [[Lesbos]], [[Greece]]. [[Hellenic Police|Police]] find the 34 survivors at shore. [https://apnews.com/article/migration-greece-boat-sinking-lesbos-e6bf00ec84e45b7a4b301df934dc32b5 (AP)]
*At least 16 people are killed after a bus is hit by a landslide in [[Himachal Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/least-10-people-killed-bus-accident-northern-india-2025-10-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/10-killed-after-bus-hit-by-landslide-in-himachals-bilaspur-district-9413350 (NDTV)]
*Four people are killed, three others are injured and others are reported missing when a former office block being converted into a hotel partially collapses in [[Madrid]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cewne4q04w4o (BBC News)]
*Over ten people are injured when a [[ferris wheel]] collapses at a fair in [[Santa Cruz de la Sierra]], [[Bolivia]]. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/10/several-injured-after-ferris-wheel-collapses-at-fair-in-bolivia/ (BNO News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of the Holy See]]
**[[Visit by Pope Leo XIV to Turkey and Lebanon]]
***The [[Holy See]] [[Holy See Press Office|Press Office]] announces that [[Pope Leo XIV]] will visit [[İznik]], [[Turkey]], the location of the ancient city [[Nicaea]], and [[Lebanon]] in November and December as his first [[papal visit]]s abroad. [https://thecatholicherald.com/article/pope-leo-xiv-to-visit-turkey-and-lebanon-in-first-apostolic-journey (''The Catholic Herald'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/pope-leo-set-to-visit-turkiye-lebanon-in-his-1st-trip-abroad/3709923 (Anadolu Agency)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Crime in Mexico]]
**Six civilians are killed and two others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] when [[Mexican Army]] soldiers open fire on a vehicle that tried to ram them on the highway connecting [[Ciudad Mante]] and [[Tampico]] in [[Tamaulipas]], Mexico. Mexican president [[Claudia Sheinbaum]] vowed an investigation. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/mexico-president-vows-thorough-investigation-into-the-killing-of-6-civilians-by-soldiers/ar-AA1O5LGn?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=68e712ec43ce42d8b63facf31be87a6d&ei=50 (MSN)]
*[[Crime in Germany]]
**[[Iris Stalzer]], the mayor-elect of [[Herdecke]], [[Germany]], is left in a critical condition. She has told investigators it was her 17-year-old adoptive African daughter who stabbed her repeatedly in her home and tortured her for hours. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/10/07/europe/germany-mayor-stabbing-herdecke-intl (CNN)] [https://apnews.com/article/germany-mayor-attack-herdecke-stabbing-0eef42f7127bed55cc54de6ec3729324 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/german-mayor-recovering-names-daughter-as-knife-attacker/a-74280405 (DW)]
*[[Crime in Norway]]
**A restaurant in [[Strømmen]], [[Akershus]], [[Norway]], receives damage after hand grenades were thrown into it. The [[Norwegian Police]] suspects gang activity with links to the [[Kurds in Sweden|Swedish–Kurdish]] criminal gang [[Foxtrot (criminal network)|Foxtrot]], arresting two teenagers shortly after the incident. [https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/Ey3yPo/to-paagrepet-etter-eksplosjon-paa-strommen (VG)]
*Residents of [[Bonaire]], a [[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Caribbean Netherlands|special municipality]] in the [[Caribbean]], file a [[class action lawsuit]] backed by [[Greenpeace]] against the Netherlands accusing them of [[omission (law)|failure to act]] in protecting the island's residents against [[climate change]], as they are legally Dutch citizens. [https://apnews.com/article/netherlands-climate-change-bonaire-hague-court-b1b1f134a51169cfa540d5b3abf81fd9 (AP)] [https://www.euractiv.com/news/bonaire-residents-take-netherlands-to-court-over-climate/ (Euractiv)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Argentina|Supreme Court]] of [[Argentina]] approves the [[extradition]] of businessman Fred Machado to the [[United States]], where he faces federal charges on [[drug trafficking]] and [[money laundering]]. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-javier-milei-extradition-fred-machado-jose-luis-espert-1ad1592aa2d418d8ddd871b0c8af918b (AP)]
*The [[Supreme Electoral Court of Costa Rica|Supreme Electoral Court]] of [[Costa Rica]] requests the [[History of the Costa Rican legislature|National Assembly]] to strip [[President of Costa Rica|President]] [[Rodrigo Chaves Robles]] of [[Immunity from prosecution (international law)|immunity]] so that he can be prosecuted for [[corruption]] charges. [https://apnews.com/article/costa-rica-president-chaves-immunity-ff11b0cbc50f134f61efdf930eb73d9c (AP)]
*Five people are arrested after an alleged assassination attempt on [[Ecuador]]ian [[President of Ecuador|president]] [[Daniel Noboa]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/10/07/americas/ecuador-president-noboa-assassination-attempt-latam-intl (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''

**[[Jeffrey Bostic]] is elected [[President of Barbados]] by the [[Parliament of Barbados|Parliament]]. He succeeds [[Sandra Mason]] and becomes the second president after [[Republicanism in Barbados|Barbados becoming a republic]]. [https://barbadostoday.bb/2025/10/08/lawmakers-unite-to-confirm-jeffrey-bostic-as-second-republican-president/ (''Barbados Today'')]
